themes.outlook: This pool attacks erosion's three documented weaknesses head-on: the orphan-tier PROLONG/REARGUE glue (atlas gates `????`, one carrier each), the total absence of in-theme survival (the preset currently has zero GUARD), and the one-copy RUPTURE timing problem — so it widens the tuning space from "one ramp, one detonation" to real front-load-vs-ramp, detonate-vs-outlast, and lean-vs-package axes. Expected metric pressure (estimate, not measured): front-loaded commons and MARK density should lift statusEngagement and dotHpFraction and push early win rate up from a curve that may already sit near the ~80% target, so the risk is overshooting early rather than undershooting; defend commons pull the other way and are the honest brake, at a statusEngagement cost the metric's enemy-side-only blind spot will exaggerate. Dead-card risk concentrates in the condition cards under blind policy (first-symptom x4 collisions, venomed-courtesy, the-last-word-festers) and encounter-dependent lines (a-thousand-cuts, terminal-diagnosis vs non-attackers); dominance risk concentrates in aggravate-the-case (multiplicative with x4 seed density) and all-wounds-at-once (a single-play kill button). One structural caution: slippery-slope is the D8 dice-valve `replacesId`, so any swap evicting it fully must re-ratify the valve seat, and mind-colored commons (name-the-flaw, catalogue-of-ills) strain the 5/5/5 color law. I would trial FIRST: (1) poisoned-well — the cleanest x4 front-load-vs-ramp A/B with the largest expected metric movement; (2) chronic-condition — the deposit-matched PROLONG probe, deliberately single-variable, which directly moves an orphan keyword's proving gate; (3) the-verdict-of-rot vs all-wounds-at-once at the rare seat — the two detonation poles bracket the known RUPTURE timing question and immediately tell us whether the finisher seat wants lean access, raw burst, or the library's utility package.

The pool's real contribution is texture oratory currently lacks on the enemy's side of the table: the current preset builds its case mostly at itself, and the atlas PREMISE row (`++!?`) records the theme's standing pathology as CONCEDE dominance, not weakness — so the highest-value experiments here are the ones that move win-share OFF the alt-win (poison/mark commons, recapitulatio's spend-the-tally, the three rival conclusions), which should lift statusEngagement comfortably past 0.2 and raise dotHpFraction, while the pure-deposit accelerants (narratio, confirmatio, QED) risk re-flattening the early~80%/mid~50% curve back toward the pre-plan-#1 100/100/100 shape. Dead-card risk concentrates in the seven off-seat reach cards (recolor-gated, unswappable solo) and in reductio/verdict-foregone, which are fuel-and-payoff halves that die when seated alone in the single rare seat; the-eighth-premise is estimated actively self-defeating as a solo swap. Archetype honesty improves on net: elenchus/ad-rem/videtur-quod give the preset an honest hallmark-adjacent DoT kill-path instead of leaning on the borrowed venom-and-vein alone. I would trial FIRST: (1) videtur-quod — lowest-risk ×4 swap with the cleanest expected statusEngagement/dotHpFraction gain; (2) recapitulatio — the sharpest test of the spend-vs-hoard tension and whether CONCEDE centrality is design or default; (3) quod-erat-demonstrandum — the highest-information high-risk swap, run explicitly as a dominance check against the atlas's nerf-target history, with confirmatio held back until QED's result calibrates the concede-acceleration risk. All directions above are hypotheses pending the /deck-tuning matrix (control vs --sandbox=swap-peroration, identical seeds).

The pool's real tuning surface is narrower than 30 cards suggests: it is all mind/body, so the heart seats (signs-and-portents x4, mirror-of-longing) are untouchable, mind commons and body uncommons need 5/5/5 repartitions that evict engine cards or add borrows, and the rare tier's only legal spell seat belongs to the-overtake — leaving five of eight mind rares (all ramp, no spender) at high dead-card risk against the atlas's own "pip engine has no uncapped spender" finding. The commons and cash-out uncommons are where the metrics should move: ember-carrying x4/x2 cards (hammer-rhythm, tempered-edge, ash-litany, brand-of-the-maker) give foundry an in-theme erosion floor its current recipe wholly lacks, which is the direct lever on statusEngagement > 0.2 and dotHpFraction, and should pull the early curve toward ~80% without touching engine constants; archetype honesty also improves, since foundry currently pressures the enemy mainly through one rare. Risk side: swapping too many manufacture cards for ember cards turns Foundry into a worse Erosion, and feed-the-fire/past-the-safe-heat lean on OVERHEAT variance the owner has flagged distaste for when stacked. I would trial first (1) hammer-rhythm vs half-step — same seat, same color, the cleanest A/B and the single biggest statusEngagement hypothesis; (2) feed-the-fire vs bootstrap-loop — the mid-band pip cash-out that directly answers the KINDLE/PIP `!???` gate note, watching mid win rate toward 50%; (3) no-wasted-heat vs the-overtake — the only frictionless rare A/B, testing DoT-scaling pour against RUPTURE burst for the finisher seat. All directions above are hypotheses pending the playtest matrix.

Penitent's problem is dominance, not weakness — atlas telemetry (seed 1) has it at mid 0.92 / late 0.40 against targets of ~0.50 / 0.25-0.35 — so this pool's value is reshaping HOW the preset wins, not raising power: the tempo-positive commons (salt-the-wound, venom-on-credit, the-mornings-resolve) would widen the curve breach, while the dilution cards (beggars-bandage, count-the-cost, absolution-on-account) are the genuinely scarce down-tuning levers. statusEngagement should rise under most swaps (enemy MARK is everywhere), but remember the metric is enemy-side-only — the pool's self-affliction texture, arguably its whole identity, is invisible to it, so a flat reading would not mean the FALLEN engine failed. The biggest archetype-honesty finding the pool enables is at the x2 seats: penitent currently leans on two off-theme mind borrows, and the uncommons here are the first chance to make it win through RECOIL/FALLEN natively (at the cost of a 5/5/5 color-law recolor, which is a needs-user-call). The tail risks worth watching are the uncapped payoff rares (every-mark-comes-due, the-last-relapse, how-much-is-enough) and the-usurers-due's draw loop — all four are >70%-impact shaped on paper. First /deck-tuning trials: (1) venom-on-credit vs sweet-poison — the cleanest same-seat same-role A/B in the pool, isolating dose shape AND the FALLEN-on-ramp cost of losing self-bleed financing; (2) the-old-habit vs against-my-judgment — it decouples FALLEN from the sweet-poison seat, which unblocks every other FALLEN experiment; (3) the-hair-shirt vs undistributed-middle — the highest-information archetype-honesty test, asking whether penitent can hold its sustain seat without a borrowed control card.

This pool's real lever is not early win rate — the atlas already flags Standstill at 100/100/100 with flat rung denial ignoring the stage curve, so early ~80% fit will need engine-side rung-regrowth, not card swaps; most rows above are honestly "flat" on winEarly. What the pool does open is (1) archetype honesty: the heart-native commons and uncommons (buridans-ass, the-patient-no, quietism, petitio-principii, the-cold-gallery) can retire two of standstill's four color-law borrows, converting oracle/akrasia chip lines into native STAGGER/BACKFIRE lines — statusEngagement (enemy-side-only) should rise almost everywhere except the pure-glue seats (epoche, laplaces-demon, the-narrowing-path); (2) a genuine finisher axis: the-collected-toll vs turnabout is the pool's best-specified A/B (tempo dividend vs total burst); and (3) a dominance hazard cluster (the-tortoises-lead, the-shut-door, stalemate, proof-by-exhaustion) that compounds the deny loop the theme is already over-curve on — trial those only after regrowth lands. I would trial FIRST: quietism and the-cold-gallery (legal same-color swaps into the fallen-grace/cassandras-burden seats — zero re-partition cost, clean un-borrow, expected statusEngagement gain), then the-collected-toll (single-seat finisher A/B against turnabout with a concrete tempo-vs-burst hypothesis), then the-inward-blow (a real trade in red-herring's x4 seat that tests drip heat vs consistency without touching the color law). All directions above are design estimates, not measurements.

Augury's known baseline is badly under-curve in the middle (atlas round 2: early ~68-69% vs the ~80% target, mid ~1% vs ~50%, OMEN payoffs failing to out-scale boss HP), so this pool's leverage is concentrated in its DoT-dense cards, not its wager cards: every OMEN carrier inherits the sim's unexercised omenClaim (ante paid, claim defaulted), so omen-heavy swaps will likely sim WORSE than they play — a measurement caveat to state in any /deck-tuning verdict, not a design failure. The tick-forward commons and uncommons (read-the-entrails, slow-writ-doom, venom-in-the-stars, writ-of-ruin) should raise statusEngagement and dotHpFraction while pulling mid win-rate toward the band; the pure-scry line (scattered-auspices, eyes-of-the-aeon, tomorrow-in-full) risks engagement dilution and dead cards unless paired with a FORETELL-cashing payoff the library does not yet have. Archetype honesty improves wherever in-theme cards displace the three body borrows, but every such swap is a 5/5/5 recolor and per standing doctrine a needs-user-call. I would trial FIRST: (1) read-the-entrails at the glimpse x4 seat — the cheapest, highest-volume lever on mid DoT throughput; (2) the-grand-prognostication at the the-oracles-eye seat — a clean A/B of "real wound now" versus the passive omen amplifier that the mid-game evidence already indicts; (3) half-spoken-prophecy at the self-flagellant seat — a like-for-like RUPTURE swap that tests theme honesty and the stake-vs-soul economy without moving the preset's power budget.

The pool attacks tithe's three documented weaknesses head-on: no defensive card anywhere in the recipe, the REAP rebuild-cycle wall behind the late 0.00 (keyword-atlas SOUL/REAP rows), and three borrow seats (disarming-smile, circular-reasoning, stuck-in-their-head) that dilute archetype honesty. Most commons and half the uncommons keep bleeds/Marks enemy-facing, so statusEngagement (>0.2 target) should hold or rise for the churn-line swaps — the real risk is the self-target defense cards (hedge, widows-portion, what-is-spared, the defensive rares) displacing disarming-smile's enemy-side SWAY, where the metric's enemy-only blind spot will read a survivability gain as an engagement loss. The early ~80% fit looks safe under almost every swap except the finisher-out rares (harvest-home, winter-count, bar-the-granary-door), which are honest hypothesis probes, not upgrades; mid ~50% should benefit most from the mind-seat consistency swaps. Dead-card exposure concentrates in the predicate cards (graveside-watch, counting-the-sheaves — both fight the rush-execute rhythm) and in the eleven re-partition-gated cards, which cannot be trialed as clean single-seat A/Bs and therefore cost multi-seat color moves per trial. First /deck-tuning trials: (1) the-second-scythe vs the-reaping — the cleanest same-color rare A/B and the direct test of the rebuild-cycle wall behind tithe's late 0; (2) chaff-fire vs brief-candle — a pure fuel-density x4 A/B with no color churn; (3) crop-rotation vs circular-reasoning — a clean mind-seat swap that simultaneously returns theme purity, tests Mark-churn as the echo-borrow replacement, and should move statusEngagement up rather than sideways. All directions above are design estimates from pricing arithmetic and recipe shape; nothing here is measured.

This pool's biggest structural lever is that it can retire all four of grace's borrowed seats (second-thoughts, measured-answer, ouroboros, crumbling-resolve) with native charm bodies, which raises archetype honesty and should push statusEngagement up almost everywhere — nearly every card carries a free RAPPORT/SWAY line, so the >0.2 engagement floor looks safe in-preset. The main tension is consistency: the borrows currently supply draw and reflect/drip HP, and the pool's replacements trade cycle for status density, so early win rate near the ~80% target could dip if both draw borrows are ejected without plain-speech / an-open-door / the-quiet-ledger compensating; the MARK line is also all-or-nothing — planters swapped without closers (or vice versa) inflate dead-card rate, so mark cards must be trialed as pairs. Alt-win pressure rises across the rares (patient-siege and crown-conceded are the two genuine >70%-impact spam risks, since SWAY is the deck's only clock), and dotHpFraction goes to effectively zero if crumbling-resolve leaves without the mark line arriving. I would trial FIRST: (1) the-white-flag-woven vs crumbling-resolve — the cleanest single-seat A/B and it settles the documented purity dent with measurable dotFrac/late-win consequences; (2) grace-under-fire vs measured-answer — a same-color, same-rarity honesty swap with low blast radius; (3) the paired mark package a-name-remembered + the-flaw-confessed into the second-thoughts seat — it answers the theme's oldest atlas weakness (no late kill path when capitulation stalls) and directly tests whether the mark-rupture clock can carry grace's late curve into the 25-35% band. All directions above are hypotheses, not measurements.

All estimates are pre-simulation hypotheses. The pool's real value is that roughly a third of it (pebble, cold-iron-nail, toll, spike-the-breach, written-in-scar, grudge, caltrops, grinding-wall, anvil) attacks bastion's documented failure mode — the atlas THORNS/RIPOSTE rows record mid ~14% because the wall cannot kill non-attackers — by adding proactive Nettle Sting clocks and a MARK-plant/ruptureMarks-cash engine, which should pull mid toward ~50%, raise dotHpFraction, and lift enemy-side statusEngagement above 0.2; the pure-defense half (dry-stone, lean, first-stone, tortoise, hedge-of-spears, last-stone, unbreachable, oath) does the opposite and mostly risks either dead-card rows or late-stage starter overperformance, since the statusEngagement metric is enemy-side-only and blind to self-THORNS. The biggest structural friction is color: the pool is heavily body-aspect while both uncommon recipe seats are heart under the 5/5/5 law, so only written-in-scar and the-siege-outlasted swap in cleanly — most other uncommon trials force a partition re-derivation or displace the four borrows, which is itself an archetype-honesty experiment worth running deliberately. Dilution risk at the x4 seats is real: any nettle-cloak replacement that drops the sting must be paired with a sting source elsewhere or the deck's only reliable clock disappears. I would trial FIRST: (1) pebble-in-the-boot on the nettle x4 seat — the cheapest, lowest-risk direct fix for mid 14 plus mark fuel; (2) written-in-scar on the common-ground seat — the one color-legal uncommon that converts those marks into a kill engine while restoring theme purity; and (3) the-anvil-speaks on the rare-spell seat — the single-card answer to the boss/passive loss mode with low variance, giving a clean three-cell A/B (sting density, payoff engine, top-end clock) before touching anything that repartitions colors.

This pool mostly attacks refrain's structural weakness: the preset is 4-borrows deep (opening-statement, winnowing, self-flagellant, venom-and-vein) because the 7-card library echo theme has no in-theme payoff below rare and no defense at all — so the biggest tuning-space change is archetype honesty, giving /deck-tuning in-theme candidates for every borrowed seat plus payoff lines (the-point-lands, the-burden-of-repetition) below the rare gate. Net metric expectation: statusEngagement up (near-universal FREE mark/mill lines and echoed applications), dotHpFraction contested between the pure-DoT wing (told-twice, each-time-worse, the-refrain-that-rots) and the rupture wing (point-lands, burden, truth-by-attrition), and early win-rate risk of overshooting the ~80% target if a common detonator lands in a x4 seat — while the glue/defend commons (murmur, breath-kept, shield-restated) risk pushing engagement down and should only enter if the matrix shows refrain dying fast. Dead-card watch: the three finale-gated cards are reachable in 15-card decks but draw-position-swingy, and anything replacing stuck-in-their-head (collected-works, unfinished-argument) risks a loop with no closer. I would trial FIRST: (1) the-burden-of-repetition vs self-flagellant — the cleanest borrow-retirement A/B and the pool's core honesty hypothesis; (2) the-second-telling vs winnowing — the on-curve mid-rank carrier that directly targets the mid ~50% fit where echoed two-status density should show up cleanly in statusEngagement; (3) the-point-lands vs opening-statement — the highest-leverage/highest-risk seat (a x4 payoff line un-gating the engine from rares), which needs early-stage spam-share measurement before anything else in the pool is judged. All directions above are pre-simulation hypotheses.
